function: Learned predictive beamforming for SWIPT-ISAC: maps multi-step historical CSI to the BS transmit beamformer, trading rate against harvested energy under a CRLB sensing constraint (p. 1; p. 6).
system: Downlink mono-static full-duplex BS with 8x8 transmit and receive UPAs; 4 UAV targets/CUs with 2x2 UPAs, LoS, 4.9 GHz; power-splitting energy harvesting; no RIS (p. 3; p. 9).
method: TSFusionNet: CNN and LSTM fusion module, differencing attention, prediction head; unsupervised training on weighted rate-energy loss with adaptive CRLB penalty (p. 6; p. 7).
data_channel: Custom simulated LoS UPA channel with 3D kinematic target motion and random initial states; path loss from [43], 4.9 GHz; 7000/2000/1000 train/validation/test samples (p. 4; p. 9).
test_conditions: Same simulated setup for training/validation/test (7000/2000/1000 samples); sweeps of transmit power, weight factor, targets, time steps, array size; no unseen-condition test stated (p. 9; p. 11).
baselines: Non-learned: ADMM, ZF, MRT. Learned: ISACformer [15], EPDNet [21], E2E-PB [16]; TSFusionNet (perfect) is a simplified variant of the proposed network (p. 9).
metrics: Averaged achievable rate, averaged harvested energy, CRLB of motion parameters (CDFs); parameters, FLOPs, inference time (p. 5; p. 6; p. 10).
complexity: 0.0845 M parameters, 0.2222 GFLOPs per batch, 0.7039 ms per sample (Table II); 96.8% fewer parameters, 81.5% fewer FLOPs than the most complex DL benchmark (p. 10).
q1_support: p. 3: "high probability of line-of-sight (LoS) transmission". Custom LoS UPA channel (Eq. 2, p. 4) with path loss from [43] (Table I, p. 9); no 3GPP, DeepMIMO or measured channel data is used.
q2_support: p. 9: "The size of the training, validation, and test sets is set" to 7000, 2000 and 1000: one simulated setup split three ways. Table III (p. 11) and Fig. 9 (p. 12) vary antennas and targets, but no model trained in one setting and tested in another is reported.
q3_support: p. 9: "a conventional method baseline, we employ the ADMM" (also ZF, MRT); p. 9: "DNN for predictive beamforming proposed in [21]" (also ISACformer [15], E2E-PB [16]). Fig. 5 (p. 10) compares their rate and harvested energy with TSFusionNet.
q4_support: p. 10: "operations (FLOPs), and inference time for DL models, while" reporting only execution time for conventional methods; Table II (p. 10) gives 0.0845 M parameters, 0.2222 GFLOPs per batch, 0.7039 ms per sample.
q5_support: p. 9: "We perform training and testing of TSFusionNet" on a self-generated simulated dataset; no code or data link, DOI or availability statement appears anywhere in the paper, and no public dataset is used.
notes: Area 5 (ISAC): the learned beamformer serves communication, power transfer and sensing through the CRLB constraint (p. 6). Area 6 was considered because the targets/CUs are UAVs (p. 3), but the BS is a terrestrial UPA, the paper never mentions NTN, and the method is not specific to aerial links; reviewer to confirm. IRS appears only in related work [17]. Tables I-III and Figs. 5-9 were read from page images (p. 9-12).
